items.headline: adidas winterises the Handball Spezial
items.caption: The WTR version adds hiking laces, metal eyelets and chunky soles.
body: Suede overlays and textured leather.
It looks genuinely hikeable.
How to wear it: with cords and a fleece.

items.headline: The Samba lost its heel and gained fluff
items.caption: The adidas Samba OG Mule is a slip-on with a cosy lining.
body: The terrace classic turns lounge shoe.
It comes in a brown colourway.
How to wear it: with thick socks around the house, or out.

items.headline: Menswear can't quit Tommy Vercetti's style
items.caption: The GTA: Vice City hero's '80s power suits and loud prints keep coming back.
body: Neon Miami, big shoulders, Hawaiian shirts.
Highsnobiety traces his influence.
How to wear it: one loud print shirt, plain trousers.

items.headline: Makeway's sleek black Nike Shox R4
items.caption: A friends-and-family-only collab from the Toronto label.
body: Black leather with reflective touches.
Its second Nike shoe after the P-6000.
How to wear it: all black, head to toe.

items.headline: Tom Glynn-Carney fights impostor syndrome with vintage
items.caption: The House of the Dragon actor on thrifting and making his own rings.
body: He makes some of his own rings.
Vintage gives his look a personal story.
How to wear it: one handmade ring, not five.

items.headline: In Saint Laurent, Archie Madekwe is ready to dance
items.caption: The actor on his surprise cameo in Madonna's Confessions II video.
body: Madonna FaceTimed him with the pitch.
He said yes on the spot.
Style lesson: sharp tailoring that can move.

items.headline: adidas and Brain Dead made a hiking sneaker for walking
items.caption: The Zuperklimb comes in brushed suede.
body: Lots of trainers want to be hiking shoes now.
Colours: Core Black or brown and auburn.
How to wear it: with nylon trousers.

items.headline: What watch will Robert Pattinson wear as Bond?
items.caption: Pattinson is the next 007, and watch fans want to know.
body: Watches are almost as Bond as dinner jackets.
Connery started with a Rolex Submariner.
Style lesson: a dive watch goes with a tux.

items.headline: Is there such a thing as a perfect blazer?
items.caption: Writer Eugene Rabkin says yes: his is by Forme d'Expression.
body: The label is by South Korean designer Koeun Park, based in Italy.
It's off the rack, but felt made for him.
How to wear it: soft shoulders, worn often.

items.headline: Subdial wants to be the UK's biggest pre-owned watch dealer
items.caption: The London firm raised up to $20 million and is heading to the US.
body: Founded in 2018 by Christy Davis and Ross Crane.
Second-hand luxury watches are booming.
Style lesson: pre-owned can be smarter money.

items.headline: Kevin Love's watch collection, from Rolex to F.P. Journe
items.caption: The NBA champion's taste changed the day he won a title.
body: Vintage Rolex sits next to independents.
Hodinkee's Talking Watches series.
Style lesson: buy what marks your milestones.

items.headline: Arnold & Son's Time Pyramid gets agate dials
items.caption: Openwork watchmaking with semi-transparent coloured stone.
body: The 42.5mm Time Pyramid now comes in agate editions.
Hodinkee has live pictures.
Style lesson: one bold dial, simple strap.

items.headline: Warren Buffett gives away $5.5B for Thanksgiving
items.caption: He says kindness 'compounds' at a better rate than stocks.
body: He converted thousands of Berkshire shares into gifts.
It's a yearly tradition for him.

items.headline: First-ever West Coast sea turtle hatchlings return to the Pacific
items.caption: Olive ridley hatchlings saved from a storm in California were released.
body: A turtle nested on America's Pacific coast for the first time on record.
Another nest followed at Huntington Beach.

items.headline: Algeria thanks a Kansas town with a trip of a lifetime
items.caption: Lawrence hosted Algeria's World Cup team; Algeria returned the favour.
body: Kansas families were greeted with flowers at 4:30 a.m.
A reminder of football's power to unite.

items.headline: Bronx gets New York's largest electric school bus fleet
items.caption: 45 electric buses now serve a neighbourhood with high childhood asthma.
body: Asthma rates there are more than twice the national average.
The buses prevent a million pounds of emissions per school year.
